Day one we walked through the thousands of red torii gates at Fushimi Inari before the crowds arrived.

Day two: Kinkaku-ji, the golden pavilion, and the moss garden at Saiho-ji, which needs a reservation by postcard. We stayed in a ryokan near Gion with a kaiseki dinner.

Day three was rainy, so we spent it at the Nishiki market tasting pickles and grilled mochi.
